before.title: The Spellbound Sea
before.shortText: Discarded Magic books are randomly assigned, then DESTROYed.
before.rulesText: On Assign: randomly assign each Magic book from your discard pile to visitors for 0 Actions. Their On Assign abilities resolve. Any options they require are chosen at random. DESTROY those books afterwards.

rebinds.name: High Tide
rebinds.text: On Assign: each Magic book in your discard pile gains +1 Value, then is randomly assigned to a visitor for 0 Actions. Their On Assign abilities resolve; options are chosen at random. DESTROY those books afterwards.

rebinds.name: Returning Tide
rebinds.after: Then 1 random one returns to hand
rebinds.text: As The Spellbound Sea, then 1 random book it DESTROYed returns to your hand.

rebinds.name: Undertow
rebinds.after: +1 Value per book DESTROYed, this Encounter
rebinds.text: As The Spellbound Sea, then it gains +1 Value for each book it DESTROYed, until the end of the Encounter.
